name: Deep Noise Suppression (DNS) Challenge Dataset
description: A speech enhancement corpus released for the Microsoft Deep Noise Suppression Challenge, comprising clean speech, noise, and reverberant mixtures for training and evaluating noise suppression systems. This is distinct from GTZAN; GTZAN is a legacy music-genre classification baseline with known flaws.
citation: Reddy, C. K. A., Dubey, H., Gopal, V., et al. (2021). The INTERSPEECH 2021 Deep Noise Suppression Challenge. https://doi.org/10.21437/Interspeech.2021-599
